messages:
mary: @everyone Heads-up: billing cycle cutoffs and free credit windows are changing next month. Please read — this affects Hosted free credits and invoice cutoff times. :wave:

jonathan: quick summary pls?

mary: TL;DR — two items:
- Cutoff for monthly invoices moves from 11:59pm UTC on the last day -> 05:00 UTC on the 2nd day of the following month (internal reason: batch consolidation + reporting latency).
- Free trial credits will now expire 90 days after issuance (was 180). Existing credits issued before the change keep current expiry.

alex: is there proration for Dedicated reserved capacity if a customer is mid-cycle?

billing-bot: @alex Per policy: reserved capacity cancellations will be handled per contract. For standard reserved-month cancellations we apply a pro-rated credit to next invoice when cancellation is submitted >=7 days before next billing cutoff. See: https://redwood.example.com/billing/policies (internal link).

sophie: will this push invoices into our accounting month? last time cutoff shifts messed up revenue reporting.

mary: Good point. Finance confirmed we'll continue recognizing revenue based on service period; the cutoff shift should not change month-of-recognition. We've added a short reconciliation guide for ops. I can post the spreadsheet.

kevin: can we get a sample notice to send to customers?

mary: Yes — communications coord'd with customer success. Customer-facing email will go out 2 weeks before the change, with an FAQ. Internal FAQ + script’s in #support. Example snippet: 

```
Subject: Upcoming update to Redwood billing cutoff & free credit terms
Hi — from DATE we will adjust our monthly invoice cutoff to 05:00 UTC on the 2nd of each month. Free trial credits issued after DATE will expire after 90 days. No action required; billing and usage will be visible in the Console. Contact support@redwood.example.com with questions.
```

jonathan: will we auto-apply credits for the ones that were supposed to expire at 180 but got moved?

mary: Existing credits keep 180-day expiry. Only credits created after the effective date use 90 days. No retroactive changes.

alex: any change to rate limits or overage policy tied to this?

mary: No rate-limit changes in this rollout. Overage thresholds and soft-limits are unchanged. We may follow up with a separate announcement if that changes.

sophie: tagging finance: @kevin please confirm ops have the reconciliation doc ready by EOD Friday.

kevin: noted. I'll drop the sheet in the #finance-files drive and ping here when done.

mary: Action items:
- CS will send customer notice (2 weeks pre).
- Docs + FAQ updated (docs owner: jonathan).
- Finance reconciliation & internal script (owner: kevin).
- Billing automation tests updated (owner: alex).

billing-bot: Automated reminder: migration playbook task created: `billing-cutoff-change-2026-09` assigned to alex, kevin, jonathan.

mary: thanks all — posting this on the company announcement page as well. Please escalate any issues in #support or ping me directly. :thumbsup:
